name: Scenes
style: Cinematic grimdark gothic sci-fi environment concept art, wide establishing shot, painted with heavy chiaroscuro and volumetric haze. Monumental architecture of blackened iron, worn bronze and soot-stained stone, cathedral-scale forge halls, hanging chains and chains of lamps, stained-glass optics glowing in the dark, rivers of molten metal, drifting incense smoke, deep shadow with a few warm key lights. Sombre, sincere, devotional, epic scale. Original design. No text, no letters, no logos, no birds, no eagles, no wings, no emblem of a skull inside a cog.

forge-cathedral.line: A vast forge-cathedral interior, tiers of iron galleries rising into darkness, immense hanging braziers, a colossal masked statue presiding over a glowing furnace floor, tiny acolytes for scale.

kiln-district.line: An industrial kiln district at dusk seen from a high walkway, ranks of chimney stacks venting ember-lit smoke, bronze pipes and gantries, a procession of lanterns winding between the furnaces.
